thread:
tia: Deploy-bot is flagging a p95 regression on /embeddings during the v3.1 canary in us-west-2. Its recommending auto-revert. Need a decision: let auto-run or manual limited rollback?
deploy-bot: ALERT: Canary p95 +27% vs baseline. Auto-revert threshold hit. Suggested action: trigger-auto-rollback. [telemetry link]
harry: Oncall here. Any 5xxs or user errors?
tia: No 5xxs, just latency. We also saw a kernel path change and a spike in KV cache miss rate.
ops-bot: POLICY: Partial routing pins during change windows require oncall + release-owner approval. Manual action will suppress auto-revert.
harry: Prefer a targeted routing pin for embeddings back to last-stable (v2.9.3) for a 30% slice to validate impact before full revert.
marie: Agreed. That minimizes blast radius and gives signal. Tia, you own release notes, ack?
tia: Ack. Marie/harry, please run the route pin.
harry: Executing: ```redwoodctl route update --service=embeddings --version=2.9.3 --scope=30% --ramp=90s --reason="canary p95 spike"```
harry: routing change applied, ramping 30% in 90s. Monitoring p95 and KV misses for pinned slice.
deploy-bot: ACTION: route change detected. embeddings -> 2.9.3 (scope 30%). Auto-revert suppressed while manual intervention active.
marie: Telemetry: p95 on pinned slice dropped ~20% within 70s; KVcache miss rate improved for that slice.
harry: Good. Ramping to 100% now per plan.
harry: Ramp complete, embeddings traffic on 2.9.3. Overall p95 returned near baseline.
deploy-bot: INFO: Canary p95 within acceptable bounds. Auto-revert suppressed.
tia: Drafting customer blurb: "During a staged rollout, we detected increased latency for embeddings. We pinned embeddings routing back to the prior stable binary (v2.9.3) and paused the rollout. No user-facing errors were observed. Engineering is investigating a kernel interaction causing cache misses and will post an update." Add a line about pause and next steps?
marie: Add: "Next steps: reproduce in staging with the same kernel flags, collect KV cache traces, and run a focused perf sweep."
tia: Added and posting to #release-notes and CS. Closing unless objections. :thumbsup:
harry: :thumbsup: closing.
ops-bot: RECORD: manual partial rollback executed by harry; approved by harry and tia. Incident state: mitigated.
